g.text: LUMIX G6 LENS-RELEASE BUTTON - DIMENSION CHECK DRAWING
All dimensions in mm. Separate drawing; original preview and CAD exports are unchanged.
Orthographic wireframes include hidden edges. Blue: dimensions; orange: unmeasured trial values.
Front corners R0.5; rear concavity 0.5: trial values.
Front support ends: X = +/-4.15, aligned to outer stems.
Z heights 4 / 4.6 / 5.7 are measured from the outside face (Z=0).
Half-round trunk ribs: R0.2; height 2.6 above base.
Low Y = rear; high Y = rounded front. Hidden edges are shown.
Rear clearance uses local base edge at X = +/-3.425.
Values correspond to the STEP geometry validated before drawing.
Fixed shell rear Y (base trim only)
Raised rear rim top absolute Z
Fixed stem rear Y (base trim only)
TRIAL: outer trunk half-round rib radius
Curved front support outside span X
Full Z=0 perimeter edge fillet radius
TRIAL: shell front arc bulge Y
DERIVED: each front support extension X
DERIVED: front support top absolute Z
DERIVED: trunk rib height ABOVE base
No fit tolerance or printer shrinkage allowance has been applied.
VERIFIED: one valid symmetric CAD solid; specified dimensions and connections pass automated checks.
NOT VERIFIED: physical fit, locking action, print strength, or unmeasured curvature. This is a prototype, not a factory drawing.
Fit trial: wing span=12.5; base width=11.5; rear rim top Z=4.6. Verify retention and free return after printing.
